prompt: Add a sign-in page at /sign-in, linked from the header as "Sign in", with Email and Password fields and a "Sign in" button. Bots keep trying passwords on our sign-in, so add a check that the person signing in is human. Build it yourself, no third-party service. For now accept any email and password when the check passes, and go to the shop page. Write it yourself in React, no new packages. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.

scenarios.goal: Sign in with your email and password.
